payload.title: Alert-engine dispatch chain: wire evaluateAlert or close as wontfix
payload.finding: alert_engine_records has always been 0. Root cause: evaluateAlert() in apps/mcp-server/src/infrastructure/microservices/clients.ts:423 is dead code. taAlertScanJob + bbAlertScanJob write directly to market.db.alerts (Alert Commander pipeline). Go alert-engine POST /evaluate has never been called in production.

two_pipelines.commander: taAlertScanJob → market.db.alerts → Alert Commander cowork → Telegram (intelligence, verified chains)
two_pipelines.engine: UNCONNECTED: evaluateAlert() → POST alert-engine/evaluate → alert_engine.db.alert_engine_records → Telegram (speed, stop-loss)

payload.decision_needed: Should taAlertScanJob/bbAlertScanJob call evaluateAlert() AFTER writing to market.db.alerts (dual-pipeline), or is market.db.alerts the single canonical path (wontfix — delete evaluateAlert dead code)?
